headwords: treo đầu dê bán thịt chó
trong cái rủi có cái may

flags.why: Tam tộc refers to three family lines or three generations, not three degrees of kinship ([dictionary](https://v2.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Tru_di_tam_t%E1%BB%99c)).
flags.fix: execution of an offender together with three family lines (paternal, maternal and marital), or three generations of the family (historical punishment)

flags.why: In metalworking, trui means to harden by quenching, whereas annealing softens the metal.
The example uses figurative trui rèn rather than the stated metalworking sense.
flags.fix: Người thợ trui lưỡi dao bằng cách nhúng nó vào nước khi còn nóng. = The craftsman quenches the blade by plunging it into water while it is still hot.

flags.why: Nướng trui means roasting directly in fire, commonly burning straw, rather than specifically grilling on charcoal ([Vĩnh Long tourism](https://vinhlongtourist.vn/vi/detailnews/?id=news_11186&t=ca-loc-nuong-trui-dac-san-vinh-long-niu-chan-du-khach)).
flags.fix: to roast directly in fire, typically burning straw (especially a whole fish)

flags.why: The translation misrepresents nướng trui as ember grilling and miền Tây as a generic western region.
flags.fix: Snakehead fish roasted in a straw fire is a specialty of the Mekong Delta.
